scope: 12-source finite engineering exploration; no low-FPR or statistical security claim
prompt_family_definition: primary depicted category; unique frozen prompt per category, disjoint category IDs across splits; purposive rather than IID sampling

allowed_policy: P0-engineering: original, JPEG Q70/Q90 subsampling2, bicubic down/up scale0.5/0.75; primary fact must remain visibly unchanged
threshold_rule: Fix patch tolerance2.0; for each cal source use minimum count across all five benign variants; choose largest nonnegative integer count threshold accepting ceil(0.9*6) source bundles. Test and negative scores never select threshold. Flag zero as degenerate.

negative_controls.unmarked: test draft generation from fixed random latent; native query-derived reference/key42; correlated with registration draft, not broad unmarked distribution
negative_controls.wrong_reference: CPU diagnostic: each test original recon vs next test original query-derived reference in frozen test source order; deliberate R1-style reference mismatch, not native instance credential or FPR

score_gate: visual review of all marked benign variants before cal/test scoring; retain all source attempts, no replacements
